title: SB128 (2025 Regular): RELATING TO TRESPASS.

other_topics: judicial-criminal-justice: SECTION 2 (new HRS 708-) — creates the non-gun crime of criminal trespass on agricultural land with fines and restitution

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Hawaii) (gun-policy Stage 5, Hawaii); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Hawaii text (Introduced, official copy, https://data.capitol.hawaii.gov/sessions/session2025/bills/SB128_.HTM; sha256 b5f5848ae02d6936bf110e34ca561907f353ac8f0a9101aa08c02f5275365deb)
provenance.note: As-filed text (introduced). SECTION 2 creates a petty misdemeanor with fines of $500 to $2,500 and restitution; it is not a gun part. Amendments made after the version read are not in the text read.

operative_text: SECTION 3 (HRS 134-7): (b) No person who is being prosecuted for one or more charges for a felony, a crime of violence, a criminal offense relating to firearms, criminal trespass on agricultural land under section 708- , or an illegal sale or distribution of any drug in a court in this State or elsewhere, or who has been convicted in this State or elsewhere of having committed a felony, a crime of violence, a criminal offense relating to firearms, criminal trespass on agricultural land under section 708- , or an illegal sale or distribution of any drug shall own, possess, or control any firearm or ammunition.
